scope: Complete causal teaching film; pinned primary-source review, no DeepInfer/vLLM runtime or own GPU benchmark

sources.supports: Bandwidth-limited small-batch decoding, conditional parallel scoring, draft cost and rejection-sampling process
Engine role, vLLM origin, supported-model/hardware and release boundaries
Confidence/hardware-aware continuous-prefix length selection, official strategy-only 60-concurrency row, decoder bounded replay
Global KV sharing, local SWA and existing bounded-replay implementation; not an exclusive DeepInfer invention
Inference engines may supply generation in training workflows; no claim of ready DeepInfer integration
Transformer stacks, representation from previous layer, attention and positionwise feed-forward transformation with distinct learned parameters per layer; three layers not a required count.

illustrations.company: Hypothetical leave application; not real company policy or an executed model response
illustrations.gpu: One schematic device represents execution resources; not a deployment-size claim
illustrations.cards: Text-fragment substitutes, not real tokenizer outputs or actual inference
illustrations.weight_transfer: Conceptual reuse under bandwidth-sensitive small-batch conditions; no measured timings
illustrations.sampling: Reject branch shown; full algorithm equations and all-accepted bonus-token branch omitted
illustrations.predictions: Qualitative bars and A=2/B=4 illustrative choices, no forecasts from a real model
illustrations.hardware_curve: Shared versus variable work decomposition, not measured duration bars or a device profile.
illustrations.dependency_grid: Three layers and ten schematic text-fragment positions in the same leave question; three-neighbor local window is a toy rule. No real tokenizer/model trace.
illustrations.bounded: Decoder suffix local-state reconstruction; global shared state retained, result for decode not prefix-cache storage
illustrations.official_row: EP64/DP64, 60 seq/rank, fixed vs dynamic strategy; 13730 to 14466 estimated tokens/s/rank, not framework comparison
illustrations.layers: A network layer is a consecutive neural computation block operating on numeric token representations. The three-block animation is a depth illustration; no fixed linguistic job assigned to any layer.
illustrations.grid_axes: Rows: successive network layers. Columns: token positions. Same column: same token position at different layer output states. Bottom position labels are schematic sequence positions.
illustrations.layer_purpose_example: Same leave request: identify person/date/duration, compose the application, relate duration to supplied teaching policy. Pedagogical stages jointly supported by model layers; not fixed one-layer-one-feature tasks.
illustrations.semantic_state_annotations: Chinese labels explain possible information content; not measured hidden-state decoding or natural-language storage.

no_claims: Own measured speed/cost gain; cited official single-configuration strategy data is explicitly scoped
